items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the blowup of the maximal ideal of a regular local ring of dimension two is an irreducible regular scheme (statement lines 726-732). The proof (proof lines 733-753) reduces regularity to closed points, uses that closed points lie on the exceptional divisor, and applies the quotient criterion with a local equation of the exceptional divisor. H2: a complete short argument in two steps.
